detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

SLU-PP-332 (Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₈H₁₄N₂O₂
  • Molecular Weight: ~290 g/mol (approximate; refer to Certificate of Analysis for exact value)
  • Compound Class: Synthetic small-molecule research compound
  • Chemical Type: Non-peptide heterocyclic compound
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

SLU-PP-332 is a synthetic small-molecule compound belonging to a non-peptide heterocyclic chemical class. It is supplied as a solid research material intended for controlled analytical and mechanistic investigation within laboratory research environments.

This product is provided in an encapsulated solid format to support controlled storage, handling, and analytical preparation. The encapsulated format serves solely as a physical containment and presentation method and does not imply any route of administration or intended method of use.

SLU-PP-332 is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals working with experimental small-molecule compounds.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of experimental small-molecule behavior in biochemical or molecular assay systems
  • Analytical method development involving heterocyclic research compounds
  • Laboratory studies examining structure–property relationships of investigational molecules
  • Comparative research involving structurally related synthetic analogues
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research compound
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in appropriate laboratory solvents following removal from the encapsulation format for analytical use
Compliance Notice:

SLU-PP-332 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
